summary: Diesel Price Reduction Act of 2026 This bill requires the Department of Commerce to prohibit the export of diesel fuel from the United States to any country during certain periods after the average price has exceeded $5.00 per gallon. Specifically, this prohibition shall apply if the diesel fuel price averages more than $5.00 per gallon for 14 consecutive days. The prohibition shall remain in effect until the diesel fuel price is below $4.50 per gallon for 30 consecutive days.
